acceptedObligations.parentText: Pure reconciliation returns independent supported wet/dry, model-estimated wet/dry, conflicting and unknown current states; WMO remains one input.

Spatial nearby/no-nearby/unavailable stays distinct from current. Horizon approaching/nearby-without-arrival/numerical-forecast/none-supported/unknown stays separate; current and approach may coexist.
Forecast retains provider/product, valid window, units, amount, optional probability and its event/window. Missing probability is not zero; amount is not observed rate.
Initial Open-Meteo current is model-estimated. Alpha supplies no present/spatial authority. No new provider, trajectory engine, minutely fetch or live arrival claim is required.
The original blanket prohibition of current-model particles is expressly amended by owner H5/H8: a direct adapter is not required for quantitatively supported MODEL ESTIMATE rain/snow.

Surviving guards reject stale, wrong-target, malformed and forecast-only live inputs. Missing/contradictory quantity is uncertainty, not particles/rate/dryness. Model thunder never authorizes observed strikes.

Adapter evidence cannot be a free trusted boolean. Provider/product, target generation, source/receipt/frame/issue/valid times, units, footprint/coverage, quality and versioned admission reason remain mandatory.

Underlying local observation age and operational health remain separate from fresh mosaic and nominal coverage. Positive and negative claims abstain on stale/unknown local age or nonoperational/interpolated data.
R0023 location intent/source/accuracy/original fix age and target generation/coordinates remain captured. Unknown IP accuracy is not invented; model-grid support remains separate.
Keep amount/rate units and preceding intervals. 0.4mm over 900s becomes 1.6mm/h interval average, not instantaneous onset. Null is not zero; overflowing derived fields stay null.

Current/forecast source and receipt ages and generation leases are independent. Source gap, rain end, outage, target change and tab-resume expiry withdraw permission without cloud retention keeping wet effects alive.
Explicit synthetic positives and preview exercise actual rain/snow/strike consumers. Identical live flags cannot upgrade production observation authority.

A qualified current wet plus model dry must record supported wet/disagreement and rain. B qualified current dry plus model rain must record dry/conflict according to policy, without universal WMO/radar veto.
C dry point with qualified nearby arrival is separate from local rain. Unqualified movement gives nearby-only/unavailable. Current rain and later approach may coexist.

D absent/outside-coverage observation with model rain remains model-estimated wet and observation unavailable. The original withholding of supported model particles is narrowly amended; this is not confirmed dry.
E an 18-minute mosaic with fresh retrieval cannot establish local observation or ETA. G weak/interpolated/ambiguous returns never become millimetres or calibrated drizzle.
Future forecast intervals are never current. Unknown native/interpolated provenance is explicit. Probability/amount and coverage/operational-health negative distinctions survive.

qaState exposes consumed target/source/fix age, valid/receipt ages, quality/coverage, point versus surrounding state, current/spatial/horizon/forecast, rejection/unavailability, permissions/expiry/reason and any derivation, without tiles or redundant forecast arrays.
R0003/B/C/E and R0023 interfaces are qualification prerequisites. R000D/R001E/R001B stay distinct owners. Renderer richness consumes evidence and cannot generate authority.
Done is the honest state/renderer contract, not useful local arrival/provider qualification or predictive skill. Containment returns to unavailable/model-estimated without alpha-mm or invented ETA.
